messages:
sam: Observed duplicate billing during a WS resume in eu-canary. New route accepted resume, old route flushed buffered tokens afterwards and billed. Anyone seen this pattern?

julia: Yep. Logs show route-swap + tombstone expiry ordering problem. Old route finalizes without checking who claimed resume.

sam: Minimal log:```
[2025-02-05T09:12:01.100Z] route=eu-a resume_id=r123 disconnect
[2025-02-05T09:12:01.210Z] route-pick chosen=eu-b resume_id=r123
[2025-02-05T09:12:01.220Z] eu-b processed 40 tokens
[2025-02-05T09:12:01.600Z] eu-a flush 40 tokens billed
```
So both bill ~400ms apart.

leo: Short-term: have finalize check central lease store; if claimed_by != this_route then skip billing. Cheap and deterministic.

sre-oncall: Add metric resume_tombstone_dupes and alert if >0.3% over 10m. Also add a console tile for per-shard dup rate.

julia: Console: billing explorer needs resume_id and route_id columns. Ops can't debug aggregated rows. I'll mock UI change.

billing-bot: audit: possible duplicate billing tenant=acme resume_id=r123 tokens=40 candidates=[eu-a,eu-b]

sam: Longer term: add token_seq per-stream and persist highest_seq in lease. Finalize only if local_final_seq > lease.highest_seq. That avoids ambiguous flush ordering.

leo: Feature-flag plan: 1) lease-check on finalize (FF on) 2) emit resume_id on billing events 3) console filter + alert. 4) rollout to canary, monitor.

julia: UX note: if we enable strict finalize, billing visibility might lag by TTL ms. Expose projected lag in rollout console banner.

sre-oncall: Agreed. If lease-store latency > 50ms, fallback to relaxed mode and tag billing events as degraded. We'll add SLO dashboard.

sam: I'll open RFC and include repro script. Pls add quick telemetry so we can measure before changing finalize behavior.

(ends)
